summary: Skipping always wins over selecting: with --tags and --skip-tags both given, skipped tags take precedence.
questions: What happens if a task matches both --tags and --skip-tags?

answer_card.title: Tag precedence
answer_card.answer_md: `--skip-tags` wins. `--tags tag1,tag3,tag4 --skip-tags tag3` runs tasks tagged `tag1` or `tag4`, but never ones tagged `tag3`, even if they also have another selected tag.
